hunks.baseline: I could’ve sworn I heard something like that.
hunks.sol: I could’ve sworn I heard it.

hunks.baseline: It was a signal that it was time to shed the illusion surrounding me and return to reality. An alarm waking my mind from its deep slumber.
hunks.sol: It was the signal that it was time to leave the illusion around me and return to reality. An alarm waking my mind from its deep slumber.

hunks.baseline: The scenery around me melted away like ice cream. The cheers that had sounded so clear now seemed distant, like echoes.
hunks.sol: The scenery around me melted away like ice cream. The shouts that had sounded so clear now seemed distant, like echoes.

hunks.baseline: The final battle of this Great War. Perhaps the final battle on which humanity’s fate would rest.
hunks.sol: The last battle of the Great War. Perhaps the final battle, with humanity’s fate hanging in the balance.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi strode forward, Hero’s Sword held high, and countless Hunters followed behind him like a surging wave.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi strode forward, the Hero’s Sword held high, and countless Hunters followed him like a surging wave.

hunks.baseline: Toward a being standing alone, cloaked in darkness.
hunks.sol: Toward a lone figure standing there, cloaked in darkness.

hunks.baseline: I reached out with all my strength. Through my blurring vision, I moved the body that had become entirely my own and took a step toward him.
hunks.sol: I reached out with all my strength. Through my blurring vision, I moved the body that was entirely my own again and took a step toward him.

hunks.baseline: I could see the back of the calamity. It wasn’t enormous or grotesque.
hunks.sol: I could see the back of that calamity. He wasn’t enormous or grotesque.

hunks.baseline: I wanted to catch even a glimpse of him buried in the deep darkness, to feel the power coiled within him, if only for a moment.
hunks.sol: I wanted to see him beneath that deep darkness, to feel the power coiled within it, if only for a moment.

hunks.baseline: *More. Just a little more!*
hunks.sol: *Closer. Just a little closer!*

hunks.baseline: Maybe my desperate cry had echoed in my heart and reached him. Or maybe everything I was seeing and feeling wasn’t an illusion after all, but something else.
hunks.sol: Maybe my desperate, silent cry had reached him. Or maybe everything I was seeing and feeling wasn’t an illusion after all, but something else.

hunks.baseline: There was only one thing I could be sure of: something had reacted to my silent cry.
hunks.sol: There was only one thing I could be sure of: something had reacted to my soundless cry.

hunks.baseline: But the Demon King was definitely turning toward me—and that was the last thing I saw.
hunks.sol: But the Demon King was turning toward me—and that was the last thing I saw.

hunks.baseline: Everything around me disappeared. Team Leader Choi and Xiao Shen, the countless Hunters. And even Demon King Asmodeus.
hunks.sol: Everything around me disappeared. Team Leader Choi and Xiao Shen, the countless Hunters. Even Demon King Asmodeus.

hunks.baseline: No—an abyss-like presence was closing in, pressing in on me from every direction.
hunks.sol: No—an abyss-like presence was closing in from every direction.

hunks.baseline: I was confused. I couldn’t make sense of anything.
hunks.sol: I was confused. I couldn’t tell what was happening.

hunks.baseline: And just as I was gripped by those questions—
hunks.sol: And just as those questions gripped me—

hunks.baseline: Clear chimes reached my ears. Their sound rang out in every direction.
hunks.sol: Clear chimes reached my ears and rang out in every direction.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the darkness that had writhed toward me like a living snake scattered rapidly.
hunks.sol: At the same time, the darkness that had writhed toward me like a living snake rapidly scattered.

hunks.baseline: It thrashed violently, as if confronted by something it feared.
hunks.sol: It shuddered violently, as if it had encountered something it feared.

hunks.baseline: The being that had conjured all those countless illusions that came crashing down on me, too.
hunks.sol: I knew what had brought all those illusions crashing down on me, too.

hunks.baseline: The short sentence meant something else, but what had happened to me was the same.
hunks.sol: The line meant something else, but it described what had happened to me.

hunks.baseline: I looked at the Doppelganger, and the Doppelganger looked at me. And so I was dragged into the abyss it had created.
hunks.sol: I looked at the Doppelganger, and the Doppelganger looked at me. That was how I’d been dragged into the abyss it had created.

hunks.baseline: No. I had been.
hunks.sol: No—that was what had happened.

hunks.baseline: And the instant I gathered my strength and tore it apart—
hunks.sol: And the instant I tore it apart—

hunks.baseline: The darkness, reduced to ash by the flames, crumbled away without a fight. Beyond it, the world I remembered came into view.
hunks.sol: The darkness crumbled away, reduced to ash by the flames. Beyond it, the world I remembered came into view.

hunks.baseline: Air mixed with dust flowed through my nose and mouth.
hunks.sol: Dusty air flowed through my nose and mouth.

hunks.baseline: But I’d experienced at least several hours—years’ worth of illusions—and returned.
hunks.sol: But I’d been gone for at least several hours, experiencing years of illusions.

hunks.baseline: It was impossible to explain in a few words, and there was no time to explain.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t explain it in a few words, and there was no time to try.

hunks.baseline: Then I turned away from him and faced the Doppelganger, who was staring up at me, dazed.
hunks.sol: Then I left him behind and faced the Doppelganger, which was staring up at me in a daze.

hunks.baseline: “You—you… What are you…?”
hunks.sol: “You… What are you…?”

hunks.baseline: Its body, wavering like a shadow, was slowly scattering—bit by bit, without pause.
hunks.sol: Its shadowy body wavered and kept scattering, bit by bit.

hunks.baseline: What I’d torn apart with my flame-filled hands wasn’t just an illusion. It was the Doppelganger’s body, its very life.
hunks.sol: What I’d torn apart with my flame-wreathed hands wasn’t just an illusion. It was the Doppelganger’s body, its very life.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. I figured there had to be some reason that dog barking its head off this whole time was cooperating so easily.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. I thought that dog barking its head off about the King was cooperating a little too easily.”

hunks.baseline: Whenever darkness welled up from it in bursts, like spurting blood, and scattered like ash, the shadow that was its body shrank.
hunks.sol: Darkness welled up from it like blood, then scattered like ash. Each time, the shadow that served as its body grew smaller.

hunks.baseline: “Honestly, it wasn’t a bad attempt. If I’d been in my usual shape, you wouldn’t have stood a chance, but… I didn’t expect some bastard to come flying in without even signaling.”
hunks.sol: “Honestly, it wasn’t a bad attempt. If I’d been in my usual shape, you wouldn’t have stood a chance. But I didn’t expect some fucker to cut in without using his turn signal.”

hunks.baseline: But if those two words referring to me weren’t just nonsense, then I knew at least this much: stopping that fucked-up scene the Doppelganger had shown me must be the mission I’d been given.
hunks.sol: But if those two names for me weren’t just nonsense, I knew this much: stopping that fucked-up future the Doppelganger had shown me must be the mission I’d been given.

hunks.baseline: “Be prepared. Everything you saw will soon become the future—and reality.”
hunks.sol: “Brace yourself. Everything you saw will soon become the future—and reality.”

hunks.baseline: “Are you sure? I may be a genius, but I’m not exactly planning to die young.”
hunks.sol: “Are you sure? I may be a genius, but I’m not planning to die young.”

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger laughed out loud at my reply. Its helplessness and madness were impossible to hide now that it had accepted its complete Erasure.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger laughed out loud at my reply. It had accepted its complete Erasure, and the emptiness and madness in its laughter were impossible to hide.

hunks.baseline: “If the King returns, will you still be able to say the same thing?”
hunks.sol: “If the King returns, will you still be able to say that?”

hunks.baseline: I thought of that last glimpse of Demon King Asmodeus, whose appearance I’d never managed to make out clearly. I thought of the overwhelming strength I’d felt from him, even from a distance.
hunks.sol: I thought of Demon King Asmodeus, whose appearance I’d never managed to make out, and the overwhelming strength I’d felt from him even at a distance.

hunks.baseline: *If I fought him, could I really win?*
hunks.sol: *If I fought him, could I win?*

hunks.baseline: But sometimes, a question can have more than one answer.
hunks.sol: But sometimes a question has more than one answer.

hunks.baseline: Especially when I’m the one solving it.
hunks.sol: Especially when I’m the one answering it.

hunks.baseline: “If it were me right now, I’d definitely die. Miserably, without even managing to hurt him properly.”
hunks.sol: “If I fought him as I am now, I’d definitely die. Miserably, without even managing to hurt him properly.”

hunks.baseline: At my answer, the Doppelganger’s laughter grew louder. It didn’t seem to care that more than half of its body had already disappeared.
hunks.sol: At my answer, the Doppelganger’s laughter grew louder. It didn’t seem to care that more than half its body had already disappeared.

hunks.baseline: “If it were me right now. That’s the most important premise.”
hunks.sol: “As I am now. That’s the important part.”

hunks.baseline: At some point, I’d changed. I’d had no choice but to change in order to survive, in order to protect what mattered.
hunks.sol: At some point, I’d changed. I’d had no choice but to change to survive and to protect others.

hunks.baseline: I’d thrown away the caution I’d held on to as an F-rank Hunter. Sometimes I’d faced my enemies with courage—and with even more recklessness.
hunks.sol: I’d thrown away the caution I’d held on to as an F-rank Hunter. Sometimes I’d faced my enemies boldly—and with even greater recklessness.

hunks.baseline: The me of now and the me of the future are different.
hunks.sol: The man I am now and the man I’ll be in the future are different.

hunks.baseline: So the future has to change, too. Whatever risks I have to take—even if it costs me my life—I’ll change it with my own power.
hunks.sol: So the future has to change, too. Whatever risks it takes—even if it costs me my life—I’ll change it with my own power.

hunks.baseline: That’s all I can do. And it must be why some unknown someone chose me.
hunks.sol: That’s all I can do. And it must be why someone I don’t know chose me.

hunks.baseline: The Middle Dantian is moved by mental strength, and mental strength comes from the firmness of one’s heart.
hunks.sol: The Middle Dantian is moved by mental strength, and mental strength comes from a steadfast heart.

hunks.baseline: I won’t be shaken by a horrible illusion, or by a few words from the Doppelganger.
hunks.sol: I won’t be shaken by some horrible illusion or a few words from the Doppelganger.

hunks.baseline: But as I looked down at the Doppelganger, which had stiffened, I wanted to make sure I said this.
hunks.sol: But as I looked down at the Doppelganger’s stiffened face, there was one thing I wanted to tell it.

hunks.baseline: I tugged at the corner of my mouth, stiff with dried blood. Then I forced the words out, fighting the sleepiness washing over me.
hunks.sol: I pulled at the corner of my mouth, stiff with dried blood. Fighting off the sleep that threatened to overwhelm me, I went on.

hunks.baseline: “I put an end to the plan you came up with. With my own hands.”
hunks.sol: “I put an end to your plan. With my own hands.”

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know exactly how the Doppelganger had planned to get the results it wanted.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know exactly what the Doppelganger had planned to do or what it had hoped to achieve.

hunks.baseline: I’d wanted to hear it directly from the thing itself, but it would be completely gone in a few seconds. There was no point asking now.
hunks.sol: I’d wanted to hear it from the thing itself, but it would be completely gone in a few seconds. There was no point asking now.

hunks.baseline: I could find everything out.
hunks.sol: I could find out the rest.

hunks.baseline: Even if I had to scour the whole world, I’d track down every trace of the Doppelganger and pull up every root it had left behind somewhere. Then the illusion would remain an illusion.
hunks.sol: Even if I had to scour the whole world, I’d track down every trace of the Doppelganger and pull up the roots it had left behind. Then the illusion would remain an illusion.

hunks.baseline: The future, once filled with horrible calamities, would be filled with peace.
hunks.sol: Peace would settle over the future that had been filled with calamity.

hunks.baseline: At long last, the world had come together as one. I’d sounded the alarm for those who’d been complacent in their peace, and doused the powerful—who’d been turning their backs on reality—with a bucket of cold water.
hunks.sol: At last, the world had come together. I’d sounded the alarm for those who’d grown complacent in times of peace and thrown cold water in the faces of the powerful who’d refused to confront reality.

hunks.baseline: And I’d brought those known as humanity’s sword and shield, the countless Hunters, together under one flag.
hunks.sol: And I’d brought those known as humanity’s sword and shield—the countless Hunters—together under one flag.

hunks.baseline: A group that transcended gender, race, age, and national borders.
hunks.sol: An organization that transcended gender, race, age, and national borders.

hunks.baseline: Everyone had chosen me. Everyone trusted and followed me. So there was no room in my heart for the word *impossible*.
hunks.sol: Everyone had chosen me. Everyone trusted and followed me. There was no room in my heart for the word *impossible*.

hunks.baseline: My vision slowly tilted against my will. Without a word, the Skeleton King suddenly came up beside me and reached out to support me.
hunks.sol: My vision slowly tilted against my will. Without a word, the Skeleton King appeared beside me and reached out to support me.

hunks.baseline: My toe came down hard, with a heavy rush of air.
hunks.sol: My foot came down hard, cutting through the air with a heavy rush.

hunks.baseline: And in that moment, an inexplicable sight flickered into my hazy vision.
hunks.sol: And in that moment, something inexplicable caught my eye through my hazy vision.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t possibly know.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t tell.

hunks.baseline: Was it a phantom brought on by exhaustion, or an incomprehensible reality?
hunks.sol: Was the smile an illusion brought on by exhaustion? Or was it a reality I couldn’t understand?

hunks.baseline: Before I could even think back over that fleeting question, the toe, still wreathed in a faint flame, had already stamped down on the shadow. It led a monster that had lived through ages beyond imagining to Erasure.
hunks.sol: Before I could think any further, my foot, still wreathed in a faint flame, stamped down on the shadow. It brought a monster that had lived through ages beyond imagining to Erasure.
